text:
Use with caution / monitor.

Ibuprofen can cause an elevation of plasma lithium levels and a reduction in renal lithium clearance [ibuprofen:drug_interactions:2], with studies showing an increased mean minimum lithium concentration and decreased renal clearance due to the inhibition of renal prostaglandin synthesis [ibuprofen:drug_interactions:3]. NSAIDs like ibuprofen may increase lithium serum concentrations [lithium:drug_interactions:0], so patients taking these drugs concurrently should be observed carefully for signs of lithium toxicity [ibuprofen:drug_interactions:3], with frequent monitoring of serum lithium concentrations and necessary dosage adjustments [lithium:drug_interactions:0].
